steps.headline: A thin outline around the chat pane — keep?
steps.changed: A 1px line in the card-outline colour runs all the way around the chat pane where it meets the frame, including the rounded corners. Framed themes only; floating layouts have no frame and don't get it.
steps.notice: Most visible on dark themes (Midnight, Dark), where the pane and the frame are close in colour. On Light it's subtle.

steps.path: Chat with the games or files drawer open
steps.headline: The side pane gets the same outline — keep?
steps.changed: When the files drawer or games panel is open, it's outlined the same way, so both panes read as two windows in one frame.
steps.notice: It sits on the same edge the pane already has; nothing moves or resizes.

steps.path: Projects (also Pages and the other full screens)
steps.headline: Full-screen panes get it too — keep?
steps.changed: The big pane on Projects, Pages and the other full screens is outlined the same way.
steps.notice: The welcome screen's frame follows the same rule.
